title: INC Allahabad Address 1930
definition: The Allahabad Address refers to the Presidential Address delivered by Sir Muhammad Iqbal at the 21st session of the All-India Muslim League in Allahabad, 1930, which provided the intellectual and political blueprint for a separate Muslim state in Northwest India.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for understanding the evolution of the Two-Nation Theory, the ideological shift in the Muslim League, and the precursor to the Pakistan Resolution (1940).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of INC Allahabad Address 1930.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
